title: planner · Pivot to inspecting specific benchmark papers for descriptive evidence
summary: Pivot to inspecting specific benchmark papers for descriptive evidence comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets, adhering to strict source limits.
body: 1. Define a bounded research scope targeting specific agent benchmark papers that report task success and hallucination rates under fixed token budgets. 2. Execute searches for papers comparing dynamic memory consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only) with controlled resource constraints. 3. Inspect exactly 4 sources meeting criteria; if fewer than 4 are found after 2 review rounds, accept the best available evidence and document limitations. 4. Record findings as descriptive only; do not infer superiority without direct baseline comparison. 5. If no suitable sources exist, revise the hypothesis to match available evidence (e.g., compare dynamic vs. static without strict budget matching) and document the scope adjustment.
